notes.title: PATCH NOTES: 1.190128164141.a
notes.content:
[h1]1.190128164141.a[/h1]
- Fixed some issues with the Freeman kids and in relation to their death.
- Fixed an issue where you could still trigger some scenes from the Freeman's house even though some of them were dead.
- Fixed an issue where Linnea was stuck in an animation loop after Gary's Death.
- Adjustments to the overall outside music
- Fixed an issue where player got stuck after quitting and loading autosave in after the mayor kill.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - 1.190118112744.a
notes.content:
[h1]1.190118112744.a[/h1]

Updates: 
-Added an alternate death for the Freeman Kids.

Fixes
-Fixed some sound issues at McGuffin's Kitchen.
-Fixed an issue where Gabriel ended up underground at his home yard.
-Fixed some shadow issues outside.
-Added some music to outside world. 
-Fixed an issue where  menu ended up under a black screen sometimes.
-Fixed some reflections that were not showing correctly
-Fixed some foliage coloring.
-Fixed an issue with Gary freeman mind control targeting in Chapter 3
-Fixed some language issues in Chinese and Spanish.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - Latest Version 1.181218205103.a
notes.content:
[h1]1.181218205103.a[/h1]
-Fixed several issues in the LtKimble church scene. 
-Fixed an issue from the Motel where painting was not working when it should have.
-Fixed an issue where bobbleheads in inventory were not matching to the statistics.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.181218032759.a
notes.content:
[h1]1.181218032759.a[/h1]
-Fixed an issue where notebook was not fully resetting on new game.
-Fixed disappearing cliffs in doctors death.
-Fixed missing lipsyncs from Cheryl Williams
-Fixed far top left cliffs missing from the world.
-Fixed some issues in the subtitle system and text should be now much more precisely tied to the voice-over. 
-Fixed an issue where the triggers did not save correctly when using autosave. (This might cause some weirdness in the save states, but mostly they should work now much better)
-Fixed some lighting when McGuffin first leaves his apartment.
-Fixed an issue where McGuffin talked over The Mayor.
-Fixed an issue where bottle was missing from couch scene
-Fixed an issue where invisible wall appeared at Morgans after doctors death.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES: 1.181217030717.a
notes.content:
[h1]1.181217030717.a[/h1]
- Fixed some issues with the church scene. The bug where the player gets stuck in an empty church instantly is should now be fixed.

[h1]1.181217001001.a[/h1]
[*] Fixed an issue with loading and black screen. When you load a game, go back to main menu and re-load a game, you would end up on a black screen.
[*]Changed the versioning to proper numbering. 
[*] Added map point to Amusement park.
[*]Fixed couple of remaining bobbleheads that did not count.
[*]Fixed some of the character offset in the shark scene.


[h1]0.181216202736.a[/h1]
[*]Fixed amusement park Double Coin problem.
[*]Fixed an issue where end-game autosave brought you back to an empty place.
[*]Added Lucifer his own save and fixed a bunch of loading issues after game is done.
[*]Fixes to church scene. Fixed an issue where the church skipped a scene instantly. There is still many issues here.
[*]Added some more brightness value to the brightness slider
[*]Fixed an issue with Banters date Paula was nude.
[*]Fixed still some more bobbleheads that were not disappearing.

[h1]0.181215204859.a[/h1]

[*]Fixed a lot of respawning bobbleheads
[*]Tried to fix the issue of Samantha running in circles when playing tag.
[*]Fixed an issue where the achievements for killing the 5 children did not trigger.
[*]Fixed some x issues with falling trough Dante Manor level
[*]Fixed an issue where McGuffin is standing outside in chapter 3
[*]Fixed an issue where player spawned too far from church in Chapter 5
[*]Fixed an issue with the main page of notebook when loading from a save. It now should save correctly the main page, and will clear the page if there is no working saves for the main page. 
[*]Fixed issues with French language showing missing translations.

[h1]0.181214183905.a[/h1]

[*]Fixed an issue where you could give the purse to Nancy while in trial.
[*]Fixed an issue where player could use the bird in Hell. This also caused an issue where jumping was temporarily not working in Hell. This should be fixed now.
[*]Fixed an issue where new game did not work after certain point.
[*]Fixed an issue where Heart had Missing translation when picked up.
[*]Fixed an issue with the vegation causing missing DLL on some systems.
[*]Fixed German and French languages and their missing translations.

notes.title: LUCIUS III is out now.
notes.content:
[h1]LUCIUS III OUT TODAY ON STEAM[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33500942/c3483d4ff9b0c365bbe2c1015213e11af6fd5704.jpg[/img]
Lucius is finally out.
It has been a long and hard road of years and years. 
We hope that you enjoy the experience and leave us your thoughts. 

If you find any issues, you can leave a comment here or use the in-game bug reporter. [F3]

We will try to iron out any issues you might find as soon as possible.


Ok guys. Good luck and have some devilish fun!

Thank you.
Shiver Games
